variants.name: sdk-distribution-verification
variants.description: Per-requirement verification receipt for the Rust, Python, and TypeScript SDK distribution decision

notes: All three SDKs remain version 1.0.0 under MIT with Prometheus AGS authorship.
Focused language tests, examples/type checks, package contents, generated docs, and streaming examples were observed locally.
Rust retains the exact runtime registry requirement; the package control plus root metadata prove the complete unresolved publication prerequisite chain.
The legacy routine CI workflow is retired; deployment workflows were not changed.
Independent artifact critic and judge both passed the release-ordered iteration-3 candidate.
